description.zh: 长城是中国最具代表性的历史建筑，绵延超过21,000公里。建于多个朝代，主要段落修建于明代。慕田峪和司马台等段落保存完好，可俯瞰壮观的山地景色。
description.en: The Great Wall stretches over 21,000 km and is China's most iconic monument. Built across dynasties, the best-preserved Ming-era sections at Mutianyu and Simatai offer stunning mountain panoramas.

zh: 世界最长的人工建筑，总长逾2万公里
慕田峪、司马台等段落风景各异
山脊上蜿蜒的视觉冲击无与伦比
en: World's longest man-made structure, over 20,000 km
Scenic sections at Mutianyu, Simatai and more
Unmatched visual drama along the mountain ridgeline

tips.zh: 避开八达岭拥挤人潮，选择慕田峪或司马台段，体验更真实；秋季红叶时节景色最美。
tips.en: Skip the crowded Badaling and opt for Mutianyu or Simatai for a more authentic experience. Autumn foliage season is spectacular.

description.zh: 故宫是世界上保存最完整的古代皇宫建筑群，占地72万平方米，拥有近万间房屋。自1420年起作为明清两代皇宫使用长达近600年，现为故宫博物院。
description.en: The Forbidden City is the world's largest and best-preserved imperial palace complex, covering 72 ha with nearly 10,000 rooms. It served as the Ming and Qing imperial palace for nearly 600 years from 1420.

zh: 世界最大的宫殿建筑群，故宫博物院
明清两朝24位皇帝的居所
en: World's largest palace complex and premier museum
Home to 24 emperors across the Ming and Qing dynasties
Over 1.8 million artefacts in the collection

admission.zh: 旺季60元，淡季40元（需网上预约）

tips.zh: 门票必须提前在官网预约，现场不售票。建议早上开门时入场避开人流。
tips.en: Tickets must be booked on the official website in advance — no on-the-day sales. Arrive at opening time to beat the crowds.
